results.title: Light it Before it Burns
results.overview: The notion of protected natural areas as an untouchable open-air museum is increasingly coming up against the reality of climate change. According to experts, one of the paradoxical tools for landscape regeneration could be controlled burning and the temporary destruction it entails. However, in Markéta Ekrt Válková’s documentary, scientific arguments and positive examples from abroad come up against the scepticism of domestic firefighters and politicians, as well as the deep-rooted fear and ignorance of the local population.

results.title: Pasukan Singa Kardus

results.overview: After a breakup, Matei returns Ioana's remaining belongings and discovers her new activity—swimming lessons—which she teaches at her home, undeterred by the lack of pools or other bodies of water in the city. results.title: 9th & Gasoline
results.overview: A visually innovative blend of documentary and music video, this emotionally triumphant work centers on B. Alexis, the first woman to release an album from prison. More than just a depiction of her life, the film channels the struggles and resilience of hundreds of thousands of trauma-impacted people, especially young Black women.
